malfunction.mdesc: Wash cycle interrupted due to power outage.

causedesc.p: Wash cycle interrupted due to power outage.
N/A

soldesc.p: Acknowledge the alarm and start the cycle again.

malfunction.mdesc: The system has discovered a problem with the I/O module

causedesc.p: The system has discovered a problem with the I/O module
N/A

soldesc.p: 1. Check the I/O module status. The LED diodes "r" or "S" must be green.
2. Check that all of I/O modules are correctly fitted.
3. Replace faulty I/O modules.

malfunction.mdesc: Wash cycle interrupted due to triggered process stop.

causedesc.p: Wash cycle interrupted due to triggered process stop.
The process stop button is pressed or breakdown in control circuit.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the process stop is reset.
2. If the machine does not have a process stop button, check -S01-X1, -S02-X1, -K31-X1 and -K31-X2 jumpers.

malfunction.mdesc: Door on the soiled side cannot be locked.

causedesc.p: Door on the soiled side cannot be locked.
Switch door locked (BG02) activated within 10 seconds of when door begins to lock, or has been inactivated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: 1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door locked (BG02) is activated within 10 seconds when the door locks.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG52) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Door on the soiled side cannot be unlocked.

2. Check that switch door unlocked (BG01) is activated within 10 seconds when the door is being locked.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG51) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Door on the soiled side cannot be closed.

causedesc.p: Door on the soiled side cannot be closed.

This error code is also displayed if the door crush protection has been tripped.

2. Check that the switch door closed (BG03) is activated within 20 seconds when the door closes.
3. Check that the motor (-M09) starts and the crush protection (BG53) is not activated.
4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

causedesc.p: Filling the chamber with water takes too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is not activated within 4 minutes from when filling starts.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the water valves (-KK01, -KK02 or -KK03) open.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Emptying the chamber taking too long.

causedesc.p: Emptying the chamber taking too long.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the drainage pump works.
2. Check that the water outlet is not blocked.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: The water level in the chamber is too low.

causedesc.p: The water level in the chamber is too low.
Water level switch (-BL15) is inactivated during wash cycle.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that there are no leaks in the chamber or circulation system.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Pressure in the circulation system is too low.

causedesc.p: Pressure in the circulation system is too low.
The pressure (BP01) is < 20 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the wash cart is properly docked in the machine.
2. Check that the pump impeller rotates freely.
3. Check that the pump impeller rotates in the right direction (see installation manual).
4. Check that the agent is not foaming.
5. Check the dosage amount.
6. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Pressure in the circulation system is too high.

causedesc.p: Pressure in the circulation system is too high.
The pressure (BP01) is > 160 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: 1. Check the spray arms and spray tubes for blockage.
2. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Water has been detected in the drying system.

causedesc.p: Water has been detected in the drying system.
Leakage detectors (-BP11 and -BP12) have been activated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the check valves in the drying system are undamaged and working as intended (no leaks).
2. Check the pressure sensor that warns of leaks.

malfunction.mdesc: One or more of the spray arms is rotating too slowly.

causedesc.p: One or more of the spray arms is rotating too slowly.
The RFID antenna has not been able to read a tag on any of the spray arms (SWRSS).

soldesc.p: 1. Check that nothing is preventing the spray wings from rotating.
2. Check that each spray arm can rotate by hand.
3. Check that the clamps holding the gratings in place on the wash cart are securely fastened.
4. Check that objects are not in contact with more than one grating on the wash cart.
5. Check the F107 (24 VDV) fuse.
6. Check that the agent is not foaming inside the chamber.
7. Check that the spray arms are not damaged.

malfunction.mdesc: Error in the circulation pump.

causedesc.p: Error in the circulation pump.
The circulation pump's load protection is triggered.

soldesc.p: Reset the load protection.

malfunction.mdesc: Temperature in the chamber is too low

causedesc.p: Temperature in the chamber is too low
The chamber temperature (-BT01) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes. Or the chamber temperature has dropped 5°C during the set temperature.

soldesc.p: Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet 6. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
5. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Temperature in the chamber is too high.

causedesc.p: Temperature in the chamber is too high.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) exceeds the set temperature by more than 5°C.

soldesc.p: 1. Check water selection in the program.
Electric heating:
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q03, -Q04) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating
2. Check that the steam valve (-KK11) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: The temperature sensors in the chamber are registering different temperatures.

soldesc.p: Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).

2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: The conductivity in the rinse water is too high.

causedesc.p: The conductivity in the rinse water is too high.
The conductivity (BQ01) is higher than set value after the third rinse cycle (adjustable).

soldesc.p: 1. Check the water connections (that the right water is connected to each inlet).
2. Check that there are no detergent leaks.
3. Check that there are deposits on the measuring cell.
4. Check that the chamber is empty after drainage.

malfunction.mdesc: The flow from the dosing pump is too low.

causedesc.p: The flow from the dosing pump is too low.

soldesc.p: 1. Check that the dosing pump (-M03) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

causedesc.p: The measured dosing volume from the Supervisor system deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the monitoring system's measured dosing volumes.

soldesc.p: 1. Check calibration of dose monitors (-BF05, -BF06, -BF07, -BF08).

causedesc.p: Wascyclus geannuleerd wegens ingedrukte stopknop.
Wash cycle interrupted due to triggered process stop.

soldesc.p: Reset de proces-stop door aan de stopknop te draaien.
1. Check that the process stop is reset.
2. If the machine does not have a process stop button, check -S01-X1, -S02-X1, -K31-X1 and -K31-X2 jumpers.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden vergrendeld.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden vergrendeld.
Door on the soiled side cannot be locked.
Switch door locked (BG02) activated within 10 seconds of when door begins to lock, or has been inactivated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door locked (BG02) is activated within 10 seconds when the door locks.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG52) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden ontgrendeld.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden ontgrendeld.
Door on the soiled side cannot be unlocked.
Switch door unlocked (BG01) is activated within 10 seconds from when the door begins to unlock.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door unlocked (BG01) is activated within 10 seconds when the door is being locked.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG51) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden gesloten.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden gesloten.
Door on the soiled side cannot be closed.
Switch door closed (BG03) is not activated within 20 seconds from when the door begins to close, or becomes inactive during an ongoing wash cycle.
This error code is also displayed if the door crush protection has been tripped.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that the switch door closed (BG03) is activated within 20 seconds when the door closes.
3. Check that the motor (-M09) starts and the crush protection (BG53) is not activated.
4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden geopend.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de vuile kant kan niet worden geopend.
Door on the soiled side cannot be opened.
Switch door open (BG04) is activated within 30 seconds from when the door beings to open.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that the switch door open (BG04) is activated within 30 seconds when the door opens.
3. Check that the motor (-M09) starts and that the cord slack switch (-S54) is not activated.
4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden vergrendeld.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden vergrendeld.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door locked (BG06) is activated within 10 seconds when the door locks.
3. Check that the motor (-M12) starts and the motor position switch (BG56) is not activated.
4. Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden ontgrendeld.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden ontgrendeld.
Door on the clean side cannot be unlocked.
Switch door unlocked (BG05) is activated within 10 seconds from when the door begins to unlock.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door unlocked (BG05) is activated within 10 seconds when the door is being locked.
3. Check that the motor (-M12) starts and the motor position switch (BG55) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden gesloten.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden gesloten.
Door on the clean side cannot be closed.
Switch door closed (BG07) is not activated within 20 seconds from when the door begins to close, or becomes inactive during an ongoing wash cycle.

malfunction.mdesc: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden geopend.

causedesc.p: Deur aan de schone kant kan niet worden geopend.

soldesc.p: Controleer of iets de deur blokkeert.

4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: Het vullen van de kamer met water duurt te lang.

causedesc.p: Het vullen van de kamer met water duurt te lang.
Filling the chamber with water takes too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is not activated within 4 minutes from when filling starts.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the water valves (-KK01, -KK02 or -KK03) open.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Het legen van de kamer duurt te lang.

causedesc.p: Het legen van de kamer duurt te lang.
Emptying the chamber taking too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is still activated after the drainage pump has been running for 2 minutes.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that the drainage pump works.
2. Check that the water outlet is not blocked.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Het waterniveau in de kamer is te laag.

causedesc.p: Het waterniveau in de kamer is te laag.
The water level in the chamber is too low.
Water level switch (-BL15) is inactivated during wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that there are no leaks in the chamber or circulation system.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Druk in het circulatiesysteem is te laag.

causedesc.p: Druk in het circulatiesysteem is te laag.
Pressure in the circulation system is too low.
The pressure (BP01) is < 20 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Zorg ervoor dat de waskar goed is gekoppeld aan de wateruitlaat in de kamer.
1. Check that the wash cart is properly docked in the machine.
2. Check that the pump impeller rotates freely.
3. Check that the pump impeller rotates in the right direction (see installation manual).
4. Check that the agent is not foaming.
5. Check the dosage amount.
6. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: De druk in het circulatiesysteem is te hoog.

causedesc.p: De druk in het circulatiesysteem is te hoog.
Pressure in the circulation system is too high.
The pressure (BP01) is > 160 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Controleer of de sproeiarmen of sproeipijpen zijn verstopt of geblokkeerd. Reinig zoals vereist.
1. Check the spray arms and spray tubes for blockage.
2. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Er is water gedetecteerd in het droogsysteem.

causedesc.p: Er is water gedetecteerd in het droogsysteem.
Water has been detected in the drying system.
Leakage detectors (-BP11 and -BP12) have been activated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that the check valves in the drying system are undamaged and working as intended (no leaks).
2. Check the pressure sensor that warns of leaks.

malfunction.mdesc: Een of meer sproeiarmen draaien te langzaam.

causedesc.p: Een of meer sproeiarmen draaien te langzaam.
One or more of the spray arms is rotating too slowly.
The RFID antenna has not been able to read a tag on any of the spray arms (SWRSS).

soldesc.p: 1. Zorg ervoor dat sproeiarmen niet worden geblokkeerd door voorwerpen op de waskar.
2. Controleer of de sproeiarmen of sproeipijpen zijn verstopt. Reinig indien nodig.
1. Check that nothing is preventing the spray wings from rotating.
2. Check that each spray arm can rotate by hand.
3. Check that the clamps holding the gratings in place on the wash cart are securely fastened.
4. Check that objects are not in contact with more than one grating on the wash cart.
5. Check the F107 (24 VDV) fuse.
6. Check that the agent is not foaming inside the chamber.
7. Check that the spray arms are not damaged.

malfunction.mdesc: Fout in de circulatiepomp.

causedesc.p: Fout in de circulatiepomp.
Error in the circulation pump.
The circulation pump's load protection is triggered.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Reset the load protection.

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatuur in de kamer is te laag

causedesc.p: Temperatuur in de kamer is te laag
Temperature in the chamber is too low
The chamber temperature (-BT01) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes. Or the chamber temperature has dropped 5°C during the set temperature.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet 6. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
5. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatuur in de kamer is te hoog.

causedesc.p: Temperatuur in de kamer is te hoog.
Temperature in the chamber is too high.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) exceeds the set temperature by more than 5°C.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check water selection in the program.
Electric heating:
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q03, -Q04) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating
2. Check that the steam valve (-KK11) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuursensoren in de kamer registreren verschillende temperaturen.

causedesc.p: De temperatuursensoren in de kamer registreren verschillende temperaturen.
The temperature sensors in the chamber are registering different temperatures.
Temperatures from sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02), deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for 5 seconds.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuur tijdens de desinfectiefase is te laag.

causedesc.p: De temperatuur tijdens de desinfectiefase is te laag.
The temperature during the disinfection phase is too low.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) does not exceed the set value for disinfection (disinfection takes too long).

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: De geleidbaarheid in het spoelwater is te hoog.

causedesc.p: De geleidbaarheid in het spoelwater is te hoog.
The conductivity in the rinse water is too high.
The conductivity (BQ01) is higher than set value after the third rinse cycle (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check the water connections (that the right water is connected to each inlet).
2. Check that there are no detergent leaks.
3. Check that there are deposits on the measuring cell.
4. Check that the chamber is empty after drainage.

malfunction.mdesc: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.

causedesc.p: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Controleer of er middel in de container aanwezig is.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M03) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.

causedesc.p: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Controleer of er middel in de container aanwezig is.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M04) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.

causedesc.p: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Controleer of er middel in de container aanwezig is.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M05) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.

causedesc.p: Het debiet van de doseerpomp is te laag.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Controleer of er middel in de container aanwezig is.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M06) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: Het vullen van de stuwtank is te traag.

causedesc.p: Het vullen van de stuwtank is te traag.
Filling the booster tank is too slow.
The water sensor (BL16) does not activate within 4 minutes from when filling begins, or it not inactivated within 1 minute from when emptying begins.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the filling valve (-KK05) opens and that the filter is not clogged.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Het legen van de stuwtank is te traag.

causedesc.p: Het legen van de stuwtank is te traag.
Emptying the booster tank is too slow.
The water level sensor (BL16) is not activated within 5 seconds from when drainage starts.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that the drainage valve (-KK06) opens.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuur in de stuwtank is te laag.

causedesc.p: De temperatuur in de stuwtank is te laag.
The temperature in the booster tank is too low.
The booster temperature (-BT04) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactor (-Q05).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK12).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuur in de stuwtank is te hoog.

causedesc.p: De temperatuur in de stuwtank is te hoog.
The temperature in the booster tank is too high.
The temperature in the booster tank is greater than 95°C or too hot according to the settings for the selected program.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Electric heating:
1. Check that the heat contactor (-Q05) has not got stuck.
2. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating
1. Check that the steam valve (-KK12) has not got stuck.
2. Check water selection in the program.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuur in het droogsysteem is te laag.

causedesc.p: De temperatuur in het droogsysteem is te laag.
The temperature in the drying system is too low.
The temperature (BT03) has not reached the set value after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that there is power on all phases up to the element (-E01).
2. Check that all 4 elements offer full effect (measure current to all elements). NOTE overloading.
3. Check that there is no leakage in the drying system.

malfunction.mdesc: De temperatuur in het droogsysteem is te hoog.

causedesc.p: De temperatuur in het droogsysteem is te hoog.
The temperature in the drying system is too high.
The temperature in the drying system is 5°C than the set value.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q02) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT03).

malfunction.mdesc: De druk in het droogsysteem is te laag.

causedesc.p: De druk in het droogsysteem is te laag.
The pressure in the drying system is too low.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is < 100 Pa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check hoses for leaks.
3. Check that the filter is correctly fitted.
4. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).
5. Check that there are no holes in the filter.

malfunction.mdesc: De druk in het droogsysteem is te hoog.

causedesc.p: De druk in het droogsysteem is te hoog.
The pressure in the drying system is too high.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is > 750 (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check if the filter is clogged.
2. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).

causedesc.p: The disinfection time is shorter than the set value. Or the process time exceeds the set value by more than double.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT02).
2. See alarm 11033.

causedesc.p: The chamber temperatures from the sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02) deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for more than 20 seconds.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).
2. Check the temperature sensor.

causedesc.p: The pressure (-BP03) is < 20 kPa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check the calibration of pressure sensor (-BP03).
2. See alarm 11023.

causedesc.p: The conductivity (-BQ01) is greater than the set value.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check calibration of conductivity meter (-BQ01).
2. See alarm 11037.

causedesc.p: The measured dosing volume from the Supervisor system deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the monitoring system's measured dosing volumes.

soldesc.p: Controleer of er middel in de container aanwezig is.
1. Check calibration of dose monitors (-BF05, -BF06, -BF07, -BF08).

malfunction.mdesc: Het controlesysteem krijgt geen signaal van het supervisorsysteem.

causedesc.p: Het controlesysteem krijgt geen signaal van het supervisorsysteem.
The monitoring system is not getting a signal from the supervisor system.
No communication between the monitoring system and Supervisor system.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Check the communication cable.

malfunction.mdesc: Fout in sensor voor analoge input.

causedesc.p: Fout in sensor voor analoge input.
Error on sensor analog in.
Analog input is outside the permitted interval.

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
1. Check the sensor (for outage or short-circuit).
2. Check the I/O module.

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatuur in de kamer is te laag

causedesc.p: Temperatuur in de kamer is te laag

soldesc.p: Bel een onderhoudstechnicus.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet 6. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
5. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q03, -Q04) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating
2. Check that the steam valve (-KK11) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: De geleidbaarheid in het spoelwater is te hoog.

1. Check that the dosing pump (-M03) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: El sistema ha descubierto un problema con el módulo E/S.

causedesc.p: El sistema ha descubierto un problema con el módulo E/S.
The system has discovered a problem with the I/O module
N/A

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check the I/O module status. The LED diodes "r" or "S" must be green.
2. Check that all of I/O modules are correctly fitted.
3. Replace faulty I/O modules.

malfunction.mdesc: Ciclo de lavado cancelado por pulsar el botón de parada.

causedesc.p: Ciclo de lavado cancelado por pulsar el botón de parada.
Wash cycle interrupted due to triggered process stop.
The process stop button is pressed or breakdown in control circuit.

soldesc.p: Reinicie la parada del proceso girando el botón de parada.
1. Check that the process stop is reset.
2. If the machine does not have a process stop button, check -S01-X1, -S02-X1, -K31-X1 and -K31-X2 jumpers.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible bloquear la puerta del lado sucio.

causedesc.p: No es posible bloquear la puerta del lado sucio.
Door on the soiled side cannot be locked.
Switch door locked (BG02) activated within 10 seconds of when door begins to lock, or has been inactivated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Compruebe si algo bloquea la puerta.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door locked (BG02) is activated within 10 seconds when the door locks.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG52) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible desbloquear la puerta del lado sucio.

causedesc.p: No es posible desbloquear la puerta del lado sucio.
Door on the soiled side cannot be unlocked.
Switch door unlocked (BG01) is activated within 10 seconds from when the door begins to unlock.

soldesc.p: Compruebe si algo bloquea la puerta.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that switch door unlocked (BG01) is activated within 10 seconds when the door is being locked.
3. Check that the motor (-M10) starts and the motor position switch (BG51) is not activated.
4. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible cerrar la puerta del lado sucio.

causedesc.p: No es posible cerrar la puerta del lado sucio.
Door on the soiled side cannot be closed.

2. Check that the switch door closed (BG03) is activated within 20 seconds when the door closes.
3. Check that the motor (-M09) starts and the crush protection (BG53) is not activated.
4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible abrir la puerta del lado sucio.

causedesc.p: No es posible abrir la puerta del lado sucio.

Switch door open (BG04) is activated within 30 seconds from when the door beings to open.

soldesc.p: Compruebe si algo bloquea la puerta.
1. Check if something is blocking the door.
2. Check that the switch door open (BG04) is activated within 30 seconds when the door opens.
3. Check that the motor (-M09) starts and that the cord slack switch (-S54) is not activated.
4. Check the chain and wire.
5. Check door adjustment according to section Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible bloquear la puerta del lado limpio.

causedesc.p: No es posible bloquear la puerta del lado limpio.

2. Check that switch door locked (BG06) is activated within 10 seconds when the door locks.
3. Check that the motor (-M12) starts and the motor position switch (BG56) is not activated.
4. Adjusting door switches.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible desbloquear la puerta del lado limpio.

causedesc.p: No es posible desbloquear la puerta del lado limpio.
Door on the clean side cannot be unlocked.
Switch door unlocked (BG05) is activated within 10 seconds from when the door begins to unlock.

soldesc.p: Compruebe si algo bloquea la puerta.

causedesc.p: No es posible cerrar la puerta del lado limpio.

malfunction.mdesc: No es posible abrir la puerta del lado limpio.

causedesc.p: No es posible abrir la puerta del lado limpio.

malfunction.mdesc: El llenado de agua de la cámara tarda demasiado.

causedesc.p: El llenado de agua de la cámara tarda demasiado.
Filling the chamber with water takes too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is not activated within 4 minutes from when filling starts.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the water valves (-KK01, -KK02 or -KK03) open.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: El vaciado de la cámara tarda demasiado.

causedesc.p: El vaciado de la cámara tarda demasiado.
Emptying the chamber taking too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is still activated after the drainage pump has been running for 2 minutes.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that the drainage pump works.
2. Check that the water outlet is not blocked.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: El nivel de agua de la cámara es muy bajo.

causedesc.p: El nivel de agua de la cámara es muy bajo.
The water level in the chamber is too low.
Water level switch (-BL15) is inactivated during wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that there are no leaks in the chamber or circulation system.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: La presión del sistema de circulación es muy baja.

causedesc.p: La presión del sistema de circulación es muy baja.
Pressure in the circulation system is too low.
The pressure (BP01) is < 20 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Asegúrese de que el carro de lavado esté bien acoplado a la salida de agua de la cámara.
1. Check that the wash cart is properly docked in the machine.
2. Check that the pump impeller rotates freely.
3. Check that the pump impeller rotates in the right direction (see installation manual).
4. Check that the agent is not foaming.
5. Check the dosage amount.
6. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: La presión del sistema de circulación es muy alta.

causedesc.p: La presión del sistema de circulación es muy alta.
Pressure in the circulation system is too high.
The pressure (BP01) is > 160 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Compruebe que los brazos aspersores o los tubos de aspersión no estén obstruidos o bloqueados. Limpie si es necesario.
1. Check the spray arms and spray tubes for blockage.
2. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Se ha detectado agua en el sistema de secado.

causedesc.p: Se ha detectado agua en el sistema de secado.
Water has been detected in the drying system.
Leakage detectors (-BP11 and -BP12) have been activated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that the check valves in the drying system are undamaged and working as intended (no leaks).
2. Check the pressure sensor that warns of leaks.

malfunction.mdesc: Uno o varios brazos aspersores giran muy despacio.

causedesc.p: Uno o varios brazos aspersores giran muy despacio.
One or more of the spray arms is rotating too slowly.
The RFID antenna has not been able to read a tag on any of the spray arms (SWRSS).

soldesc.p: 1. Asegúrese de que los brazos aspersores no estén bloqueados por objetos del carro de lavado.
2. Compruebe si los brazos aspersores o los tubos de aspersión están obstruidos. Límpielos en caso necesario.
1. Check that nothing is preventing the spray wings from rotating.
2. Check that each spray arm can rotate by hand.
3. Check that the clamps holding the gratings in place on the wash cart are securely fastened.
4. Check that objects are not in contact with more than one grating on the wash cart.
5. Check the F107 (24 VDV) fuse.
6. Check that the agent is not foaming inside the chamber.
7. Check that the spray arms are not damaged.

malfunction.mdesc: Error en la bomba de circulación.

causedesc.p: Error en la bomba de circulación.
Error in the circulation pump.
The circulation pump's load protection is triggered.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Reset the load protection.

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatura en la cámara demasiado baja.

causedesc.p: Temperatura en la cámara demasiado baja.
Temperature in the chamber is too low
The chamber temperature (-BT01) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes. Or the chamber temperature has dropped 5°C during the set temperature.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet 6. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
5. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatura en la cámara demasiado alta.

causedesc.p: Temperatura en la cámara demasiado alta.
Temperature in the chamber is too high.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) exceeds the set temperature by more than 5°C.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check water selection in the program.
Electric heating:
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q03, -Q04) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating
2. Check that the steam valve (-KK11) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Los sensores de temperatura de la cámara registran temperaturas diferentes.

causedesc.p: Los sensores de temperatura de la cámara registran temperaturas diferentes.
The temperature sensors in the chamber are registering different temperatures.
Temperatures from sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02), deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for 5 seconds.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).

malfunction.mdesc: La temperatura de la fase de desinfección es demasiado baja.

causedesc.p: La temperatura de la fase de desinfección es demasiado baja.
The temperature during the disinfection phase is too low.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) does not exceed the set value for disinfection (disinfection takes too long).

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: La conductividad del agua de aclarado es demasiado alta.

causedesc.p: La conductividad del agua de aclarado es demasiado alta.
The conductivity in the rinse water is too high.
The conductivity (BQ01) is higher than set value after the third rinse cycle (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check the water connections (that the right water is connected to each inlet).
2. Check that there are no detergent leaks.
3. Check that there are deposits on the measuring cell.
4. Check that the chamber is empty after drainage.

malfunction.mdesc: El flujo de la bomba de dosificación es demasiado bajo.

causedesc.p: El flujo de la bomba de dosificación es demasiado bajo.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Compruebe que haya agente en el contenedor.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M03) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: El flujo de la bomba de dosificación es demasiado bajo.

causedesc.p: El flujo de la bomba de dosificación es demasiado bajo.

soldesc.p: Compruebe que haya agente en el contenedor.

2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: El flujo de la bomba de dosificación es demasiado bajo.

The flow from the dosing pump is too low.

3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: El llenado del depósito amplificador tarda demasiado.

causedesc.p: El llenado del depósito amplificador tarda demasiado.
Filling the booster tank is too slow.
The water sensor (BL16) does not activate within 4 minutes from when filling begins, or it not inactivated within 1 minute from when emptying begins.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the filling valve (-KK05) opens and that the filter is not clogged.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: El vaciado del depósito amplificador tarda demasiado.

causedesc.p: El vaciado del depósito amplificador tarda demasiado.
Emptying the booster tank is too slow.
The water level sensor (BL16) is not activated within 5 seconds from when drainage starts.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that the drainage valve (-KK06) opens.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: La temperatura del depósito amplificador es demasiado baja.

causedesc.p: La temperatura del depósito amplificador es demasiado baja.
The temperature in the booster tank is too low.
The booster temperature (-BT04) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactor (-Q05).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK12).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: La temperatura del depósito amplificador es demasiado alta.

causedesc.p: La temperatura del depósito amplificador es demasiado alta.
The temperature in the booster tank is too high.
The temperature in the booster tank is greater than 95°C or too hot according to the settings for the selected program.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
Electric heating:
1. Check that the heat contactor (-Q05) has not got stuck.
2. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating
1. Check that the steam valve (-KK12) has not got stuck.
2. Check water selection in the program.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: La temperatura del sistema de secado es demasiado baja.

causedesc.p: La temperatura del sistema de secado es demasiado baja.
The temperature in the drying system is too low.
The temperature (BT03) has not reached the set value after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that there is power on all phases up to the element (-E01).
2. Check that all 4 elements offer full effect (measure current to all elements). NOTE overloading.
3. Check that there is no leakage in the drying system.

malfunction.mdesc: La temperatura del sistema de secado es demasiado alta.

causedesc.p: La temperatura del sistema de secado es demasiado alta.
The temperature in the drying system is too high.
The temperature in the drying system is 5°C than the set value.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q02) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT03).

malfunction.mdesc: La presión del sistema de secado es demasiado baja.

causedesc.p: La presión del sistema de secado es demasiado baja.
The pressure in the drying system is too low.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is < 100 Pa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check hoses for leaks.
3. Check that the filter is correctly fitted.
4. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).
5. Check that there are no holes in the filter.

malfunction.mdesc: La presión del sistema de secado es demasiado alta.

causedesc.p: La presión del sistema de secado es demasiado alta.
The pressure in the drying system is too high.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is > 750 (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check if the filter is clogged.
2. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).

causedesc.p: The disinfection time is shorter than the set value. Or the process time exceeds the set value by more than double.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT02).
2. See alarm 11033.

causedesc.p: The chamber temperatures from the sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02) deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for more than 20 seconds.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).
2. Check the temperature sensor.

causedesc.p: The pressure (-BP03) is < 20 kPa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check the calibration of pressure sensor (-BP03).
2. See alarm 11023.

causedesc.p: The conductivity (-BQ01) is greater than the set value.

soldesc.p: Llame a un técnico de mantenimiento.
1. Check calibration of conductivity meter (-BQ01).
2. See alarm 11037.

causedesc.p: The measured dosing volume from the Supervisor system deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the monitoring system's measured dosing volumes.

soldesc.p: Compruebe que haya agente en el contenedor.
1. Check calibration of dose monitors (-BF05, -BF06, -BF07, -BF08).

Check the communication cable.

malfunction.mdesc: Napełnianie komory wodą trwa za długo.

causedesc.p: Napełnianie komory wodą trwa za długo.
Filling the chamber with water takes too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is not activated within 4 minutes from when filling starts.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the water valves (-KK01, -KK02 or -KK03) open.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Opróżnianie komory trwa za długo.

causedesc.p: Opróżnianie komory trwa za długo.
Emptying the chamber taking too long.
The water level switch (-BL15) is still activated after the drainage pump has been running for 2 minutes.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that the drainage pump works.
2. Check that the water outlet is not blocked.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Za niski poziom wody w komorze.

causedesc.p: Za niski poziom wody w komorze.
The water level in the chamber is too low.
Water level switch (-BL15) is inactivated during wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that there are no leaks in the chamber or circulation system.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Ciśnienie w układzie obiegowym jest zbyt niskie.

causedesc.p: Ciśnienie w układzie obiegowym jest zbyt niskie.
Pressure in the circulation system is too low.
The pressure (BP01) is < 20 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Upewnić się, że wózek wsadowy jest prawidłowo połączony z wylotem wody w komorze.
1. Check that the wash cart is properly docked in the machine.
2. Check that the pump impeller rotates freely.
3. Check that the pump impeller rotates in the right direction (see installation manual).
4. Check that the agent is not foaming.
5. Check the dosage amount.
6. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Ciśnienie w układzie obiegowym jest zbyt wysokie.

causedesc.p: Ciśnienie w układzie obiegowym jest zbyt wysokie.
Pressure in the circulation system is too high.
The pressure (BP01) is > 160 kPa (adjustable value)

soldesc.p: Sprawdzić, czy ramiona i rury natryskowe nie są zablokowane. W razie potrzeby wyczyścić.
1. Check the spray arms and spray tubes for blockage.
2. Check the pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Wykryto wodę w układzie suszenia.

causedesc.p: Wykryto wodę w układzie suszenia.
Water has been detected in the drying system.
Leakage detectors (-BP11 and -BP12) have been activated during an ongoing wash cycle.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that the check valves in the drying system are undamaged and working as intended (no leaks).
2. Check the pressure sensor that warns of leaks.

malfunction.mdesc: Co najmniej jedno ramię natryskowe obraca się zbyt wolno.

causedesc.p: Co najmniej jedno ramię natryskowe obraca się zbyt wolno.
One or more of the spray arms is rotating too slowly.
The RFID antenna has not been able to read a tag on any of the spray arms (SWRSS).

soldesc.p: 1. Sprawdzić, czy ramiona natryskowe nie są blokowane przez przedmioty znajdujące się na wózku wsadowym.
2. Sprawdzić, czy ramiona i rury wsadowe są zatkane. W razie potrzeby wyczyścić.
1. Check that nothing is preventing the spray wings from rotating.
2. Check that each spray arm can rotate by hand.
3. Check that the clamps holding the gratings in place on the wash cart are securely fastened.
4. Check that objects are not in contact with more than one grating on the wash cart.
5. Check the F107 (24 VDV) fuse.
6. Check that the agent is not foaming inside the chamber.
7. Check that the spray arms are not damaged.

malfunction.mdesc: Błąd pompy obiegowej.

causedesc.p: Błąd pompy obiegowej.
Error in the circulation pump.
The circulation pump's load protection is triggered.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Reset the load protection.

malfunction.mdesc: Zbyt niska temperatura w komorze.

causedesc.p: Zbyt niska temperatura w komorze.
Temperature in the chamber is too low
The chamber temperature (-BT01) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes. Or the chamber temperature has dropped 5°C during the set temperature.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet 6. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
5. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Zbyt wysoka temperatura w komorze.

causedesc.p: Zbyt wysoka temperatura w komorze.
Temperature in the chamber is too high.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) exceeds the set temperature by more than 5°C.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check water selection in the program.
Electric heating:
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q03, -Q04) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating
2. Check that the steam valve (-KK11) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Czujniki temperatury w komorze wskazują różne temperatury.

causedesc.p: Czujniki temperatury w komorze wskazują różne temperatury.
The temperature sensors in the chamber are registering different temperatures.
Temperatures from sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02), deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for 5 seconds.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).

malfunction.mdesc: Zbyt niska temperatura w fazie dezynfekcji.

causedesc.p: Zbyt niska temperatura w fazie dezynfekcji.
The temperature during the disinfection phase is too low.
The chamber temperature (-BT01) does not exceed the set value for disinfection (disinfection takes too long).

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactors (-Q03, -Q04).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK11).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT01).

malfunction.mdesc: Zbyt wysoka przewodność wody do płukania.

causedesc.p: Zbyt wysoka przewodność wody do płukania.
The conductivity in the rinse water is too high.
The conductivity (BQ01) is higher than set value after the third rinse cycle (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check the water connections (that the right water is connected to each inlet).
2. Check that there are no detergent leaks.
3. Check that there are deposits on the measuring cell.
4. Check that the chamber is empty after drainage.

malfunction.mdesc: Przepływ zapewniany przez pompę dozowania jest zbyt niski.

causedesc.p: Przepływ zapewniany przez pompę dozowania jest zbyt niski.
The flow from the dosing pump is too low.
The measured dosing volume deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the set value.

soldesc.p: Sprawdzić, czy w pojemniku znajduje się środek.
1. Check that the dosing pump (-M03) works.
2. Check that there is agent in the container.
3. Check the flow meter function and that there are not air pockets.
4. Check that the flow in the hoses is not blocked.
5. Check dose monitor calibration in terms of both time and pulsing.

malfunction.mdesc: Przepływ zapewniany przez pompę dozowania jest zbyt niski.

causedesc.p: Przepływ zapewniany przez pompę dozowania jest zbyt niski.

malfunction.mdesc: Napełnianie zbiornika dodatkowego trwa za długo.

causedesc.p: Napełnianie zbiornika dodatkowego trwa za długo.
Filling the booster tank is too slow.
The water sensor (BL16) does not activate within 4 minutes from when filling begins, or it not inactivated within 1 minute from when emptying begins.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that the shutoff valves are open and that water reaches the machine.
2. Check that the filling valve (-KK05) opens and that the filter is not clogged.
3. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Opróżnianie zbiornika dodatkowego trwa za długo.

causedesc.p: Opróżnianie zbiornika dodatkowego trwa za długo.
Emptying the booster tank is too slow.
The water level sensor (BL16) is not activated within 5 seconds from when drainage starts.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that the drainage valve (-KK06) opens.
2. Check level sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatura w zbiorniku dodatkowym jest zbyt niska.

causedesc.p: Temperatura w zbiorniku dodatkowym jest zbyt niska.
The temperature in the booster tank is too low.
The booster temperature (-BT04) has not increased by at least 5°C (adjustable) after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Electric heating:
1. Check that both elements are working at full effect (measure all currents). If the internal overheating protection has tripped, the whole element must be replaced.
2. Check the heating contactor (-Q05).
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating:
1. Check the steam valve (-KK12).
2. Check that the ball valve is open and that the steam filter is clean.
3. Check steam pressure (see installation manual).
4. Check condensate outlet.
5. Check that there is no back pressure in the condensate outlet.
6. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatura w zbiorniku dodatkowym jest zbyt wysoka.

causedesc.p: Temperatura w zbiorniku dodatkowym jest zbyt wysoka.
The temperature in the booster tank is too high.
The temperature in the booster tank is greater than 95°C or too hot according to the settings for the selected program.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
Electric heating:
1. Check that the heat contactor (-Q05) has not got stuck.
2. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).
Steam heating
1. Check that the steam valve (-KK12) has not got stuck.
2. Check water selection in the program.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (-BT04).

malfunction.mdesc: Temperatura w układzie suszenia jest zbyt niska.

causedesc.p: Temperatura w układzie suszenia jest zbyt niska.
The temperature in the drying system is too low.
The temperature (BT03) has not reached the set value after heating for 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that there is power on all phases up to the element (-E01).
2. Check that all 4 elements offer full effect (measure current to all elements). NOTE overloading.
3. Check that there is no leakage in the drying system.

causedesc.p: Temperatura w układzie suszenia jest zbyt wysoka.
The temperature in the drying system is too high.
The temperature in the drying system is 5°C than the set value.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check that the heat contactor (-Q02) has not got stuck.
3. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT03).

malfunction.mdesc: Ciśnienie w układzie suszenia jest zbyt niskie.

causedesc.p: Ciśnienie w układzie suszenia jest zbyt niskie.
The pressure in the drying system is too low.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is < 100 Pa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check that both fans are working (-M07, -M08).
2. Check hoses for leaks.
3. Check that the filter is correctly fitted.
4. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).
5. Check that there are no holes in the filter.

malfunction.mdesc: Ciśnienie w układzie suszenia jest zbyt wysokie.

causedesc.p: Ciśnienie w układzie suszenia jest zbyt wysokie.
The pressure in the drying system is too high.
Pressure difference (-BP02) is > 750 (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check if the filter is clogged.
2. Check pressure sensor (-BP02).

causedesc.p: The disinfection time is shorter than the set value. Or the process time exceeds the set value by more than double.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensor (BT02).
2. See alarm 11033.

causedesc.p: The chamber temperatures from the sensors for controlling and independent temperature monitoring (-BT01 and -BT02) deviate from each other by more than ±1°C for more than 20 seconds.

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.
1. Check the calibration of temperature sensors (-BT01, -BT02).
2. Check the temperature sensor.

causedesc.p: The pressure (-BP03) is < 20 kPa (adjustable).

soldesc.p: Skontaktować się z serwisem.

2. See alarm 11023.

causedesc.p: The conductivity (-BQ01) is greater than the set value.

causedesc.p: The measured dosing volume from the Supervisor system deviates >15% (adjustable value) from the monitoring system's measured dosing volumes.

soldesc.p: Sprawdzić, czy w pojemniku znajduje się środek.
