malfunction.mdesc: CPU Power failure

causedesc.p: The power to the control system is interrupted for more than 10 seconds during the process. The control system gets no record of what happened during power failure.

soldesc.p: Check the main power, fuses and circuit breakers.
If the alarm repeats, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Power failure

causedesc.p: The power to the control system is interrupted for more than 10 seconds during the process. The control system gets no record of what happens during power failure

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check the main power, fuses and circuit breakers.

malfunction.mdesc: Faulty I/O card

causedesc.p: An I/O card reports a failure, or the CPU detects a communication failure with an I/O module. The control system is not able to control or supervise the machine.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check the communication bus cables and circuit boards. Replace if necessary.

malfunction.mdesc: Emergency stop

causedesc.p: The emergency stop button is activated.

soldesc.p: Check that no emergency situation exists and release the emergency stop button.
If no emergency button has been activated, check the electrical circuits.
Release the emergency stop button.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door failure

causedesc.p: The door position switch indicates that the door is not closed within 15 seconds, or the alarm is enabled during the process. Potentially dangerous situation for user.

soldesc.p: Check that the tolerance for the door switch is 3 to 5 mm when the door is closed and that the sterilizer is powered off or in stand-by mode,
Check input for door signal. Use electrical drawing for error search.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door seal failure

causedesc.p: A pressure switch indicates low door seal pressure for 15 seconds during the process. Doors must be sealed during the process and a leak can affect the sterilization result.

soldesc.p: Check for leakage on the door seal tubing to and from the gasket.
Check the door gasket condition.
Check for leaks in the chamber.
Check the pressure switch set point and function.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door seal leak

causedesc.p: The control system detected a leak in the door seal. Doors must be sealed during the process and a leak can affect the sterilization result.

soldesc.p: Check for leakage on the door seal tubing to and from the gasket.
Check the door gasket condition.
Check for leaks in the chamber.
Check the pressure switch set point and function.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Vacuum pump failure

causedesc.p: No return signal within 15 seconds from the motor contactor when the pump has been activated. Not possible to evacuate chamber or retract door gasket.

soldesc.p: Check the feedback signal from the vacuum pump contactor's digital output.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Low sterilization temperature

causedesc.p: The temperature registered by the controlling temperature sensor is below the sterilization temperature. The alarm is enabled after the first 15 seconds of the sterilization phase.

soldesc.p: Check the media steam to the chamber.
Check the sterilizer's drain system.
Verify the temperature sensor calibration.
Check the temperature sensor position.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High sterilization temperature

causedesc.p: The temperature registered by the controlling temperature sensor is above the sterilization temperature by more than 2.5°C . The alarm is enabled after the first 15 seconds of the sterilization phase to protect heat sensitive load and detect overheated steam, since it can affect the sterilization result.

soldesc.p: Check the incoming steam valve.
Verify the temperature sensor calibration.
Check the temperature sensor position.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Low chamber pressure

causedesc.p: The pressure registered by the chamber pressure sensor is lower than the calculated saturated steam pressure for the sterilization temperature. This indicates superheated stem, sensor problems, or poor calibration and will affect the sterilization result. The alarm is enabled after the first 15 seconds in the sterilization phase.

soldesc.p: Check the steam quality, the steam might be superheated.
Check calibration for temperature and pressure.
Check the drain system to make sure it is not blocked or clogged.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High chamber pressure

causedesc.p: The pressure registered by the chamber pressure sensor is higher than calculated saturated steam pressure for sterilization temperature +3°C (or + 4°C for effluent cycles). This indicates air or other non-condensable gases in the chamber, sensor problems, or poor calibration and this will affect the sterilization result. The alarm is enabled during the sterilization phase.

soldesc.p: Check calibration of the temperature and pressure sensors.
Check for leaks in the chamber.
Check for causes to non-condensable gases.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High jacket temperature

causedesc.p: The jacket temperature sensor is above the sterilization temperature by more than 4°C . The alarm is enabled when jacket heating is activated during the process. The load gets heated by the jacket instead of the steam in the chamber. Also risk for overheating the steam in the chamber.

soldesc.p: Check the valve for steam to jacket.
Check the temperature sensor position.
Verify the temperature sensor calibration.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Leak rate test failure

causedesc.p: Chamber pressure raises more than 0.0013 bar(0.019 psi) per minute during the leak test. A leak can affect the result of the sterilization cycle. The alarm is enabled during the leak test cycle.

soldesc.p: Check for leaks in the chamber.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Massive leak test failure

causedesc.p: Chamber pressure is greater than 0.5 bar(a)(7.25 psia) after pressure stabilization. A leak can affect the result of a sterilization cycle. The alarm is enabled during the leak test cycle.

soldesc.p: Check for leaks in the chamber.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Rupture disc

causedesc.p: Pressure switch or indication wire indicates a leaking disc. With a ruptured disk, the chamber is no longer sanitary.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check the rupture disc, the pressure switch and its wiring

malfunction.mdesc: High condensate level

causedesc.p: Detecting high condensate level in chamber drain making the chamber drain temperature drop below sterilization temperature - 1°C.

soldesc.p: Check for a blocked chamber drain, chamber drain bypass or a stuck check valve in drain. Excessive over loading with liquids, wet steam or inoperative dehumidification system may also give this alarm.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Process stop

causedesc.p: A fault situation was detected and the user pressed the stop button on the panel.

soldesc.p: Ensure that the reason the stop button was pressed is solved.
Abort or continue the cycle.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator water level

causedesc.p: Low water level in the steam generator for more than 50 seconds. There is a risk of overheating the elements.

soldesc.p: Check the water supply to the steam generator.
Check the feed water pump function and the electrical circuit.
Check the related signals and I/O modules.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator fill time

causedesc.p: Water filling takes more than 4 minutes from low to normal level. This indicates a fault in the water supply or in the normal level switch, which might cause overfilling of the steam generator.

soldesc.p: Check the water level through the sight glass.
Check the water supply to the steam generator.
Check the feed water pump function and the electrical circuit.
Check the related signals and I/O modules.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator interlock

causedesc.p: The steam generator interlock circuit indicates a fault that persists for more than 50 seconds. Heating is interlocked, no steam is produced.

soldesc.p: Check the components of the interlock circuit.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator interlock

causedesc.p: The steam generator interlock circuit indicates a fault that persists for more than 50 seconds. Heating is interlocked, no steam is produced.

soldesc.p: Check the components of the interlock circuit.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Feed water pump failure

causedesc.p: No return signal from motor controller when pump is activated. Not possible to fill water, evacuate chamber, or retract door seal

soldesc.p: Check the motor protection.
Check the contactors for the feed water pump.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Sensor misplaced

causedesc.p: The load sensor is not placed in the load during the gravity air phase. This means no control of the liquid load temperature. Portentously dangerous situation.

soldesc.p: Cancel the process and correct the sensor's placement.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Running on UPS

causedesc.p: The power to the machine is interrupted. The control system is running on UPS power. It is not possible to control the machine. It can only be monitored.

soldesc.p: Check the main power fuses and circuit breakers.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Air detector failure

causedesc.p: The air detector's sensor temperature is lower than expected. This indicates air or other non-condensable gases in the chamber which affects sterilization results.

soldesc.p: Check for leaks.
Check for air or other non-condensable gases in the steam.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Filter wetting failure

causedesc.p: The filter pressure has not reached the pressure limit within the specified time. The air filter is defect or there is a leak in the filter piping. The alarm is enabled during the wetting phase of the WIT test.

soldesc.p: Check that valve B57 is open.
Check the filter cartridge for leakage.
Check for leaks on the filter piping system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Filter pressure stabilization failure

causedesc.p: A leak is detected during the pressure stabilization. The air filter is defect or there is a leak in the filter piping. The alarm is enabled during the stabilization phase of the WIT test.

soldesc.p: Check the filter cartridge for leakage.
Check for leaks on the filter piping system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Filter leak rate test failure

causedesc.p: Filter pressure drops more than 0.0XX bar during the 10 minute leak test time. (Accepted leak is calculated using filter house volume)

soldesc.p: Check the filter cartridge for leakage.
Check for leaks on the filter piping system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door wedge position failure

causedesc.p: Wedge unlocked for 15 seconds during the process. This may affect the users safety.

soldesc.p: Check the door wedge locking system.
Check the signal to the system from the door interlock system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door cassette failure

causedesc.p: The door cassette is open for 15 seconds during the process. This may affect the users safety.

soldesc.p: Close the door cassette.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Faulty drain valve position

causedesc.p: The output status and the valve feedback does not correspond. The alarm has a delay of 15 seconds. Risk of contamination.

soldesc.p: Check the drain valve function.
Check the valve feed block function.
Check the valve feedback component.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: No service water

causedesc.p: The water level in the sealant water tank for the vacuum pump is not reached within 5 minutes.

soldesc.p: Check the incoming water supply for the vacuum pump.
Check the level switch and the signal to the control system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Air supply failure

causedesc.p: A pressure switch indicates a low incoming air pressure for more than 15 seconds of the process. The machine cannot run without air media.

soldesc.p: Call the facility manager to check that the air supply to the sterilizer is switched on.
Check the incoming air supply.
Check the pressure switch set point and function.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Water supply failure

causedesc.p: A pressure or level switch indicates low incoming water pressure/level for more than 15 seconds during the process. The machine cannot run without water media.

soldesc.p: Call the facility manager to check that the water supply to the sterilizer is switched on.
Check the incoming water supply.
Check the pressure switch set point and function.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam supply failure

causedesc.p: A pressure switch indicate low incoming steam pressure for more than 15 seconds of the process. The machine cannot run without steam media.

soldesc.p: Call the facility manager to check that the steam supply to the sterilizer is switched on.
Check the incoming steam supply.
Check the pressure switch set point and function.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door seal timeout

causedesc.p: The door seal pressure switch was not activated within a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check for leakage on door gasket, incoming piping system and drain.
Check door gasket condition.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Pressure timeout

causedesc.p: The chamber pressure did not reach the high pressure limit within a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check incoming supply media.
Check valve functionality.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Vacuum timeout

causedesc.p: The chamber pressure has not reached the low pressure limit within a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check the vacuum pump system.
Check for leaks in the vacuum system.
Check the cooling water supply.
Check the temperature on incoming cooling water.
Check the vacuum pump electrical function.
Check the valves involved in vacuum phase.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Heat timeout

causedesc.p: The temperature sensors did not reach the temperature limit within a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check the incoming media steam supply.
Check the valve function for steam inlet to chamber or filter.
Check the steam generator.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Sterilization timeout

causedesc.p: The temperature sensors indicated a temperature below the sterilization temperature for more than a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check incoming steam media supply.
Check the temperature calibration.
Check the temperature sensors.
Check for blocking or clogging in the drain system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Cooling timeout

causedesc.p: The load temperature sensors did not reach the cooling temperature within a specified time.

soldesc.p: Check for blocking or clogging in the drain system.
Check for steam supply leakage into chamber.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door interlock

causedesc.p: Faulty door switch, faulty wiring, or loose/missing door switch/latch.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door seal interlock

causedesc.p: Faulty door pressure switch, faulty wiring, or blocked/kinked pressure line.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Chamber pressure interlock

causedesc.p: Faulty chamber pressure switch, faulty wiring, or blocked/kinked pressure line.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Load temperature interlock

causedesc.p: Faulty temperature sensor, faulty wiring, or interlock relay.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Wedge interlock

causedesc.p: The wedge position switch is faulty.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Cassette interlock

causedesc.p: The door cassette contacts are faulty.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Supervisor error

causedesc.p: Supervisor communication problem. Independent supervisor not possible.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: AI-Failure+'sensor name'

causedesc.p: The control system detected a faulty sensor or a sensor value out of range during the process. The alarm text depends on the faulty sensor (for example, AI Failure Pressure, AI Failure Jacket). The control system is not able to control or supervise the process with faulty sensors.

soldesc.p: Check the sensor and its wiring. Replace the faulty part.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Vaporizer temperature

causedesc.p:
The formaldehyde vaporizer temperature is below 100°C
[212°F] during the formaldehyde cycle. The temperature is too low for vaporizing formaldehyde which is essential for the sterilization result.

soldesc.p: Check the steam feeding to the vaporizer.
Check that the steam trap is working properly.
Check the vaporizer temperature sensor.
Check the valve for steam to the vaporizer.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Faulty jacket temperature

causedesc.p:
The jacket temperature does not match the sterilization temperature with a tolerance of +5 to -9°C
[41 to -48.2°F] during the process. A large temperature difference affects the sterilization result.

soldesc.p: Check the jacket temperature sensor.
Check the calibration for the jacket temperature sensor.
Check for leakage in the jacket system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High chamber temperature

causedesc.p:
The chamber temperature is above the sterilization temperature by more than + 3°C
[37.4°F] during the formaldehyde cycle.

soldesc.p: Check the incoming steam supply to the chamber.
Check the temperature sensor's calibration.
Check the temperature sensor for damages or defects.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High chamber pressure

causedesc.p:
The chamber pressure is above limits:0.535 bar(a)[7.75 psia] when the sterilization temperature is 80°C
[176°F] (0.292 bar(a)[4.23 psia] for 65°C
[140°F] , 0.195 bar(a)[2.83 psia] for 55°C
[131°F] ). This is to protect temperature sensitive products as a high pressure indicates high temperature. The alarm is enabled from the pre-pulse phase to the end of the post-pulse phase.

soldesc.p: Check the incoming steam supply to the chamber.
Check the pressure and temperature sensor's calibration.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Emergency evac.

causedesc.p:
Chamber temperature is more than 4°C
[39.2°F] above the sterilization temperature or the jacket temperature is more than 9°C
[48.2°F] above the sterilization temperature. The alarm is enabled from the start phase to the end of the sterilization phase, plus the pressure rise in post-pulse and air-pulse phases (auto abort process). This is to protect temperature sensitive products from critically high temperatures.

soldesc.p: Check the jacket temperature sensor.
Check the calibration for the jacket temperature sensor.
Check for leakage in the jacket system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Emergency evac.

causedesc.p:
The chamber pressure is above 0.556 bar(a)[8 psia] when the sterilization temperature is 80°C
[176°F] (0.305 bar(a)[4.42 psia] for 65°C
[149°F] , 0.202 bar(a)[2.93 psia] for 55°C
[131°F] ). This is to protect temperature sensitive products from critically high temperatures as the high pressure indicates a high temperature. The alarm is enabled from the pre-pulse phase to the end of the sterilization phase, plus the pressure rise in post-pulse phase (auto abort process).

soldesc.p: Check the incoming steam supply to the chamber.
Check the pressure and temperature sensor's calibration.
Contact a local service technician.
The process aborts automatically.

malfunction.mdesc: Jacket temp. diff

causedesc.p:
The two jacket temperature sensors differ more than 2°C
[35.6°F] during the sterilization phase. This is to protect the product as it indicates a faulty temperature sensor.

soldesc.p: Check the calibration.
Check the temperature sensors for damages or defects.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Form. drain fault

causedesc.p: Formaldehyde bottle was not emptied during post treatment within 25 minutes. The bottle drain is clogged.

soldesc.p: Clean the bottle drain from residue. Use personal protective equipment as recommended.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Form. interlock

causedesc.p: Formaldehyde bottle was emptied before the sterilization phase was reached. There is not enough formaldehyde to run a sterilization cycle.

soldesc.p: Check valves for formaldehyde inlet to vaporizer.
Check for leakage on bottle and in the bottle holder system.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Form. drain line

causedesc.p: It takes more than 20 seconds to reach vacuum in the drain after the vacuum pump is started. This alarm is to prevent undertow from the drain into the chamber.

soldesc.p: There is a leak in the vacuum system. Perform a leak test to determine the cause of the leak. Use personal protective equipment as recommended.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: I/O configuration fault

causedesc.p: A faulty I/O configuration is detected by the system.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check if any I/O cards are broken or put in wrong place.

malfunction.mdesc: Supervisor configuration fault

causedesc.p: A faulty configuration of the supervisor is detected by the system.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
There is a configuration problem on the machine. Contact the second line support to get support.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam gen. contactors

causedesc.p: The contactors for the heat elements in the steam generator are not switching.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check the contactors, wiring and output from control system.

malfunction.mdesc: I/O read/write fault

causedesc.p: I/O read or write routine reported an fault.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check if any I/O cards are broken or put in wrong place.

malfunction.mdesc: Faulty I/O calibration data

causedesc.p: The calibration data file is corrupted or missing.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check that there is calibration data for all analog inputs.

malfunction.mdesc: Temp sensor deviation

causedesc.p: Steam generator heating constantly activated more than 2 minutes when steam consumption should be low.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Calibrate the temperature sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Sterilization deviation

causedesc.p: The supervisor detects faulty sterilization temperature or short sterilization time.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check for faulty chamber/drain PT-100 sensor calibration and/or a faulty I/O-board.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator pressure

causedesc.p: Steam generator heating constantly activated more than 2 minutes when steam consumption should be low.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check contactors, heating elements, and the pressure transmitter.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator level sensor

causedesc.p: The level switches indicate high and low water level at the same time.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.
Check the two level switches. Controlling the water level in the sight glass might give an indication on witch component that is faulty.

malfunction.mdesc: Battery error

causedesc.p: Low voltage in backup battery detected during standby phase. Risk of losing data during power outage. It is still possible to start a new cycle without replacing the battery.

soldesc.p: Backup the program and replace the battery on the main board.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Wait for jacket

causedesc.p: Faulty jacket temperature at the beginning of a cycle. The jacket is not within ±3 °C of set point. The jacket temperature is a critical part of the sterilization process.

soldesc.p: Wait. Cycle automatically continues when jacket temperature is within ±3 °C of set point.

malfunction.mdesc: Maintenance

causedesc.p: A preset service interval has occurred, and maintenance is requested to ensure safe operation of the sterilizer. It is still possible to start a new cycle without action.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Open prohibited

causedesc.p: The chamber is contaminated and opening the door is prohibited.

soldesc.p: Restart cycle. Try and process the goods anew.

Contact the chief hygienist to decide if it is safe to open the door even if the goods are not properly sterilized. If permitted, contact a local service technician to activate the key and open the door.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Decontamination ready

causedesc.p: The decontamination process is ready. The load in the chamber is processed and ready to be unloaded.

soldesc.p: Open the door and unload the goods.

malfunction.mdesc: High condensate level

causedesc.p: The condensate level in the chamber drain is high, but not high enough to affect the chamber drain temperature sensor during the sterilization phase. Suppressed first 2 minutes of phase. The chamber drain bleeder is blocked.

soldesc.p: Check for a blocked chamber drain, chamber drain bypass or a stuck check valve in drain. Excessive over loading with liquids, wet steam or inoperative dehumidification system may also give this indication.
Contact a local service technician if reoccuring.

malfunction.mdesc: High condensate level

causedesc.p: A high condensate level in the chamber drain is detected, causing the chamber drain temperature to drop below sterilization temperature by more than 1°C . This indicates a blocked chamber drain bleeder. Buildup of condensate in the chamber, drain, cold point. The alarm is enabled after 2 minutes in the cGMP of the sterilization phase (once per process).

soldesc.p: Check the drain system so it is not blocked or clogged.
Check the function of the level sensor, replace if broken or defect.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door not closed

causedesc.p: Doors must be closed to run a cycle.

soldesc.p: Check that all doors are closed properly.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door seal pressure

causedesc.p: Door seal should not be pressurized in standby mode for Non barrier doors. Door seal must be pressurized in standby mode for Barrier doors.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Active alarm

causedesc.p: All alarms must be acknowledged before starting a new cycle.

soldesc.p: Clear all alarms and try to start a new cycle.
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Door key switch

causedesc.p: The door key switch is activated, and the sterilizer is in maintenance mode.

soldesc.p: Check that the door key switch is not active.
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Low steam media

causedesc.p: A low pressure on the incoming steam media is detected in the standby phase.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Low air media

causedesc.p: A low pressure on the incoming air media is detected in the standby phase.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Low water media

causedesc.p: A low pressure or level on the incoming water media is detected in the standby phase.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Steam generator

causedesc.p: The steam generator has not reached working pressure, or is in test mode.

soldesc.p: If possible, check that the feed water supply is available.
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.
Check the elements, wiring, and the boiler interlock circuits (High temperature, level switch and pressure) .

malfunction.mdesc: Low jacket temperature

causedesc.p: The jacket temperature is lower than jacket controller setpoint -3 °C (5.4 °F).

soldesc.p: Check that the jacket temperature is rising (20 - 30 minutes).
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: High jacket temperature

causedesc.p: The jacket temperature is higher than jacket controller setpoint +3 °C (5.4 °F).

soldesc.p: Check that the jacket temperature is dropping (20 - 30 minutes).
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Ruptured disc

causedesc.p: A pressure switch or indication wire indicates a leaking disc. With a ruptured disc, the chamber is no longer sanitary.

soldesc.p: Remove the disc and check for damage. Replace if necessary.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Documentation not ready

causedesc.p: Printout of cycle report is interrupted if new cycle is started before the printout is ready.

soldesc.p: Make sure that there is paper in the printer and that there is no visible paper jam.
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: No valid program

causedesc.p: No valid program is selected or there is a corrupted program parameter file.

soldesc.p: Select the appropriate program
Select the appropriate program

malfunction.mdesc: Missing load sensor

causedesc.p: Program for liquids in closed container does not function without a load temperature sensor.

soldesc.p: Check that the load temperature sensor is fitted in the container.
If the message is still displayed, contact a local service technician.

Check that expected temperature difference is appropriate for the container size. Very small containers such as ampules and vials follows the chamber temperature quite well. The expected difference is adjustable in the range of 0-5°C.

malfunction.mdesc: Machine stopped

causedesc.p: The machine is in stop mode. After an alarm the machine must be restarted.

soldesc.p: On the touchscreen, open the Menu. Tap Process Control and then tap Continue.
On the touchscreen, open the Menu. Tap Process Control and then tap Continue.

malfunction.mdesc: Interlock fault

causedesc.p: A fault in the safety interlocks is detected. The machine needs service of the redundant safety interlocks.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician
Check the Alarm & Messages/Alarm & Messages History to see the reason for the interlock.

malfunction.mdesc: Hibernation

causedesc.p: The machine is in hibernation to save energy. The machine waits for wake-up time.

soldesc.p: Wait for wake-up time to elapse or tap Wake up on the touchscreen to terminate the Hibernation.
Wait for wake-up time to elapse or tap Wake up on the touchscreen to terminate the Hibernation.

malfunction.mdesc: Run leak test

causedesc.p: A leak has been detected. The sterilization can´t be guaranteed if there is a leak.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician
Find the leak and repair it. Run a successful leak rate test.

malfunction.mdesc: Jacket heat off

causedesc.p: The jacket heating is turned off. For most programs the jacket must be heated before started.

soldesc.p: Open and close the door.
Open and close the door.

malfunction.mdesc: F0 value to low

causedesc.p: The combination of sterile temperature and sterile time results in a too low F0 value.

soldesc.p: Select a combination with longer sterile time and/or higher sterilization temperature to get a higher F0 that is expected to achieve a sterile result.
Select a combination with longer sterile time and/or higher sterilization temperature to get a higher F0 that is expected to achieve a sterile result.

malfunction.mdesc: Power lost

causedesc.p: There is no power to the machine.

soldesc.p: Check the power supply to the machine.
The power has been interrupted for less than 10 seconds. Check the power supply to the machine.

malfunction.mdesc: Manual outputs

causedesc.p: One or more output is in manual mode. Output in manual mode affects the cycle.

soldesc.p: Contact a local service technician
Check for manually activated outputs and set to automatic mode.

malfunction.mdesc: Step manually

causedesc.p: Faulty pressure or temperature sensor makes it necessary to manually advance process. Cycle is halted and waits for technician to manually step sequence forward.

soldesc.p: Step sequence forward to continue the cycle.
Change the faulty sensor.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Equalize and step manually

causedesc.p: Faulty pressure sensor makes it necessary for manually equalization of chamber pressure. Cycle is halted and waits for technician to manually equalize chamber pressure.

soldesc.p: Step sequence forward to continue the cycle.
Equalize chamber pressure manually.
Change the faulty sensor.
Contact a local service technician.

malfunction.mdesc: Support manually

causedesc.p: Faulty pressure sensor makes it necessary to manually control support pressure when cooling liquids in closed containers. The chamber pressure needs to be controlled manually.

malfunction.mdesc: Fuse

causedesc.p: Fuse for UV lamp and EDI is triggered

soldesc.p: Replace EDI power supply. Replace UV lamp power supply. Replace fuse.

malfunction.mdesc: RO motor protection

causedesc.p: RO pump is stopped by the motor circuit breaker

soldesc.p: Check motor protection settings. Ensure 400V 3-phase supply. Ensure incoming water pressure does not exceed specifications. Check for blockage or RO membrane malfunction. Replace motor protection unit.

malfunction.mdesc: Distribution motor protection

causedesc.p: Distribution pump is stopped by the motor circuit breaker

soldesc.p: Check motor protection settings. Venting distribution pump if needed. Check distribution loop for blockage. Ensure 400V 3-phase supply. Replace motor protection unit.

malfunction.mdesc: Feed no pressure

causedesc.p: No pressure on the incoming water supply detected

soldesc.p: Ensure incoming water supply is within specification. Replace pressure sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Feed low pressure

causedesc.p: Low pressure during water production

soldesc.p: Ensure incoming water supply is within specification. Clean coarse filter. Replace PrePak.

malfunction.mdesc: High incoming conductivity

causedesc.p: The incoming conductivity is above set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure high incoming conductivity setting is correct. Replace PrePak. Ensure softener setting is correct. Check incoming water for contamination.

malfunction.mdesc: High RO circulation flow

causedesc.p: The RO circulation flow is above set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure high RO circulation flow limit setting is correct. Adjust RO flows with needle valves.

malfunction.mdesc: Low RO circulation flow

causedesc.p: The RO circulation flow is below set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure low RO circulation flow limit setting is correct. Adjust RO flows with needle valves.

malfunction.mdesc: High RO drain flow

causedesc.p: The RO drain flow is above set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure high RO drain flow limit setting is correct. Adjust RO flows with needle valves.

malfunction.mdesc: Low RO drain flow

causedesc.p: The RO drain flow is below set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure low RO drain flow limit setting is correct. Adjust RO flows with needle valves.

malfunction.mdesc: High RO product conductivity

causedesc.p: The conductivity after RO filtration is above set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure high RO product conductivity setting is correct. Replace PrePak. Replace RO membrane.

malfunction.mdesc: High EDI flow

causedesc.p: The flow into the EDI is above set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure high EDI flow limit setting is correct. Adjust RO flows with needle valves.

malfunction.mdesc: Low EDI flow

causedesc.p: The flow into the EDI is below set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure low EDI flow setting is correct. Check for internal leakage. Check for internal blockage. Ensure incoming water pressure meets specifications.

malfunction.mdesc: No production flow

causedesc.p: No flow over the product flow sensor is detected

soldesc.p: Check machine for leakage. Replace water flow sensor. Replace magnet valve.

malfunction.mdesc: Low production flow

causedesc.p: The flow into the tank is below set threshold

soldesc.p: Ensure product target flow setting is correct. Ensure low product flow percentage setting is correct. Ensure incoming water pressure meets specifications. Check for internal leakage. Check for internal blockage.

malfunction.mdesc: High product conductivity

causedesc.p: The product conductivity is above set threhold

soldesc.p: Ensure high product conductivity setting is correct. Replace PrePak. Replace RO membrane. Ensure EDI power supply functions correctly.

malfunction.mdesc: Low tank level

causedesc.p: Tank level is getting close to empty. Distribution not yet halted.

soldesc.p: Ensure machine is in normal operation. Ensure start production level setting is correct. Ensure start distribution tank level setting is correct. Check peak water consumption.

malfunction.mdesc: Critically low tank level

causedesc.p: Distribution stopped due to empty tank

soldesc.p: Ensure incoming water supply. Ensure machine is in water production mode. Check distribution loop for leakage. Check peak water consumption. Replace water level sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Tank overflow

causedesc.p: Water level in tank too high

soldesc.p: Ensure tank type setting is correct. Ensure stop production setting is correct. Replace water level sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: High distribution conductivity

causedesc.p: The conductivity of the tank loop is above set limit

soldesc.p: Ensure high distribution limit setting is correct. Flush distribution loop via service mode 2. Decontaminate distribution loop.

malfunction.mdesc: Low salt level

causedesc.p: Salt level in container is low

soldesc.p: Refill salt container. Clean salt level sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Replace PrePak

causedesc.p: PrePak filter has expired

soldesc.p: Replace PrePak.

malfunction.mdesc: Replace UV lamp

causedesc.p: UV lamp has expired

soldesc.p: Replace UV lamp.

malfunction.mdesc: CIP

causedesc.p: -- LEGACY -- Not used in current machines

soldesc.p: Not used!

malfunction.mdesc: Replace RO filter

causedesc.p: RO filter has expired

soldesc.p: Replace RO membrane.

malfunction.mdesc: Replace air filter

causedesc.p: Air filter has expired

soldesc.p: Replace air filter.

malfunction.mdesc: Flush RO timeout

causedesc.p: Timeout reached when flushing the RO filter after service mode or before production start

soldesc.p: Ensure RO flush end limit setting is correct. Increase production and service flush timeout settings. Replace RO membranes. Calibrate conductivity sensor. Replace conductivity sensor.

malfunction.mdesc: Loop flush timeout

causedesc.p: Timeout reached when flushing the tank loop after service mode 2

soldesc.p: Ensure loop flush end limit conductivity setting is correct. Increase loop timeout setting. Decontaminate distribution loop.

A00 POWER FAIL

causedesc.p: Power outage

soldesc.p: In the event of a power failure, the process stops.
The error code is generated when the power returns.

malfunction.mdesc: A01 MCCB TRIP

causedesc.p: Tripped motor cut out on the circulation pump.

soldesc.p: a. Check the circulation pump.
b. Check the chamber element.
c. Check the drying element.
d. Check the booster element.

malfunction.mdesc: A02 SLOW FILL C

causedesc.p: Slow filling of chamber tank. The chamber tank takes more than 2 minutes to fill.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the chamber valve.
b. Check the function of the level sensor inthe chamber (-B11).

malfunction.mdesc: A03 SLOW DRAIN

causedesc.p: Emptying the chamber takesmore than 2 min.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the emptying valve.
b. Check the function of the level sensor inthe chamber (-B11).

malfunction.mdesc: A04 W LEAK DRYER

causedesc.p: Water leakage in the dryer.

soldesc.p: a. Check the check valves to the dryer connection.
b. Check the function of the leak sensor inthe dryer (-B12).

malfunction.mdesc: A05 LOCK SS

causedesc.p: Soiled-side door does not lock within 3 seconds of program start or the door isunlocked while a program is running. The soiled-side switches for locked andunlocked are activated at the same time.

Soiled-side door does not lock within 3 seconds of program start or the door is unlocked while a program is running. The switches on the soiled-side for locked and unlocked are activated at the same time.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M16).
b. Check the function of the sensor for locked door on the unclean side (-S02).
c. Check the function of the relay (-K11).

malfunction.mdesc: A06 UNLOCK SS

causedesc.p: Soiled-side door does not unlock within 3 seconds after the end of a program.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M16).
b. Check the function of the sensor for locked door on the unclean side (-S02).
c. Check the function of the relay (-K11).

malfunction.mdesc: A07 CLOSED SS

causedesc.p: Soiled-side door did not close upon program start or the door is open while a program is running.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the sensor for the closed door on the soiled side (-S03).

malfunction.mdesc: A09 LOCK CS

causedesc.p: The door on the clean side does not lock within 3 seconds of program start orthe door is unlocked while a program is running. The clean-side switches forlocked and unlocked are activated at the same time.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M17).
b. Check the function of the locked-door sensor on the clean side (-S05)
c. Check the function of the relay (-K12).

malfunction.mdesc: A10 UNLOCK CS

causedesc.p: Clean-side door does not unlock within 3 sec. after the end of a program.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M17).
b. Check the function of the locked-door sensor on the clean side (-S05)
c. Check the function of the relay (-K12).

malfunction.mdesc: A11 CLOSED CS

causedesc.p: The clean-side door did not close upon program start or the door is open while a program is running.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the closed-door sensor on the clean side (-S07).

malfunction.mdesc: A13 DOSING 1

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 1. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 sec. of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosage pump function (-M03).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B16) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A14 DOSING 2

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 2. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosage pump function (-M04).
b. Check that there is detergent in thecontainer.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B17) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A15 DOSING 3

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 3. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosage pump function (-M05).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter (-B18) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A16 DOSING 4

causedesc.p: Low flow, detergent 4. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosage pump function (-M06).
b. Check that there is detergent in thecontainer.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B19) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A18 CONDUCTIV H

causedesc.p: The conductivity is above 4 µS/cm after three final rinse attempts.

soldesc.p: a. Check that the correct type of water is connected.
b. Check that there is no detergent leaking in.
c. Check that there are no deposits on the sensor.
d. Check the emptying.

malfunction.mdesc: A19 CIRC PRESS L

causedesc.p: The pressure from the circulation pump is below 8 kPa. There is a delay of five seconds before the circulation pump starts.

soldesc.p: a. Check the docking between machine and wash rack.
b. Check the direction of rotation of the circulation pump.
c. Check that the detergent is not foaming.
d. Check the amount of detergent dosed.
e. Prolong filling time (TI50 and TI51) by a couple of seconds.

malfunction.mdesc: A20 CIRC PRESS H

causedesc.p: The pressure from the circulation pump is higher than 130 kPa.

soldesc.p: a. Check that no nozzles in the washing armsare blocked.

malfunction.mdesc: A21 DRY PRESS L

causedesc.p: Drying pressure below 150 Pa. There is a delay of 5 sec. before the dryer fan starts.

soldesc.p: a. Check whether the hoses are broken.
b. Check that the filter is intact and properly mounted.
c. Check the function of the fan.

malfunction.mdesc: A22 DRY PRESS H

causedesc.p: Drying pressure above 750 Pa.

soldesc.p: a. Check if the filter is obstructed.
b. Check the check valve.

malfunction.mdesc: A23 DRYER TEMP L

Low temperature in dryer.
The temperature in the dryerhas not increased to the following within 4 minutes of heating: 15 °C under the reference point.

soldesc.p: a. Check that there is power on all phases upto the element.
b. Check that the airways to the filter are clear.

malfunction.mdesc: A24 DRYER TEMP H

causedesc.p: The temperature in the dryer is above 130 °C.

soldesc.p: a. Check that the heating contactor is notstuck.

malfunction.mdesc: A25 CHAMB TEMP L

causedesc.p: Low temperature in the chamber The temperature in the dryer has not increased by 10 degrees °C within 8 min. of heating.

soldesc.p: Possible action for electrical heated machine:
a. Check that there is no break in the element.
b. Check that the heating contactor is not stuck.
Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check the steam valve.
b. Check that the ball valve is open and that the incoming steam filter is clean.
c. Check the steam pressure.
d. Check condensate drain.
e. Check that there is no back-pressure in the condensate drain.

malfunction.mdesc: A26 CHAMB TEMP

causedesc.p: The temperature in the chamber is more than 5°C above the current reference point.

soldesc.p: Possible action for electrical heated machine:
a. Check that the heating contactor is notstuck.
b. Check that incoming water is not hotterthan the set value.
Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check that the steam valve is not stuck.
b. Check that incoming water is not hotterthan the set value.

causedesc.p: The temperature difference between the chamber sensors is more than 3 °C for 3 seconds.

soldesc.p: a. Check the calibration of the temperature sensors.
b. Check the function of the temperature sensors.

Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check that the steam valve is not stuck.

soldesc.p: a. Check the temperature sensor (for outageor short-circuit)

b. Check the function of the water valves.
c. Check the function of the level sensor inthe process tank (-B30).

b. Check the function of the level sensor in the drainage tank (-B32).

The clean-side switches forlocked and unlocked areactivated at the same time.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M17).
b. Check the function of the locked-door sensor on the clean side (-S05).
c. Check the function of the relay (-K12).

malfunction.mdesc: A10 UNLOCK CS

causedesc.p: Clean-side door does not unlock within 3 seconds after the end of a program.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the door motor (-M17).
b. Check the function of the locked-door sensor on the clean side (-S05).
c. Check the function of the relay (-K12).

malfunction.mdesc: A11 CLOSED CS

causedesc.p: The clean-side door did not close upon program start or the door is open while a program is running.

soldesc.p: a. Check the function of the closed-doorsensor on the clean side (-S07).

malfunction.mdesc: A13 DOSING 1

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 1. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosing pump function (-M03).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B16) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A14 DOSING 2

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 2. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosing pump function (-M04).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B17) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A15 DOSING 3

causedesc.p: Low flow of detergent 3. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosing pump function (-M05).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter (-B18) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A16 DOSING 4

causedesc.p: Low flow, detergent 4. The amount of detergent has not increased by 5 ml within 3 seconds of dosing.

soldesc.p: a. Check the dosing pump function (-M06).
b. Check that there is detergent in the container.
c. Check that there is no air in the flowmeter(-B19) and that it is working.
d. Check that the hoses are not blocked.
e. Check the calibration of the flowmeter.

malfunction.mdesc: A18 CONDUCTIV H

causedesc.p: The conductivity is above 4 µS/cm after three final rinse

soldesc.p: a. Check that the correct type of water is connected.
b. Check that there is no detergent leaking in.
c. Check that there are no deposits on the sensor.
d. Check the emptying process.

malfunction.mdesc: A19 CIRC PRESS L

causedesc.p: The pressure switch for the chamber level lost the signal during the process, or the pressure from the circulation pump is lower than 20 kPa (option pump pressure monitoring).

soldesc.p: a. Check the docking between machine and wash rack.
b. Check the direction of rotation of the circulation pump.
c. Check that the detergent is not foaming.
d. Check the amount of detergent dosed.
e. Prolong filling time (TI50 and TI51) by a couple of seconds.

malfunction.mdesc: A20 CIRC PRESS H

causedesc.p: The pressure from the circulation pump is higher than 130 kPa.
The pressure (-B04) from the circulation pump is higher than 130 kPa.

soldesc.p: a. Check that no nozzles in the washing arms are blocked.

malfunction.mdesc: A21 DRY PRESS L

causedesc.p: Drying pressure below 150 Pa. There is a delay of 5 seconds before the dryer fan starts.

soldesc.p: a. Check whether the hoses are broken.
b. Check that the filter is intact and properly mounted.
c. Check the function of the fan.

malfunction.mdesc: A22 DRY PRESS H

causedesc.p: Drying pressure above 750 Pa.

soldesc.p: a. Check if the filter is obstructed.
b. Check the check valve.

malfunction.mdesc: A23 DRYER TEMP L

causedesc.p: Low temperature in dryer.
The temperature in the dryer has not increased to the following within 4 minutes of heating: 15°C under the reference point.

soldesc.p: a. Check that there is power on all phases up to the element.
b. Check that the airways to the filter are clear.

malfunction.mdesc: A24 DRYER TEMP H

causedesc.p: The temperature in the dryeris above 130°C.

soldesc.p: a. Check that the heating contactor is not stuck.

malfunction.mdesc: A25 CHAMB TEMP L

causedesc.p: Low temperature in the chamber The temperature in the dryer has not increased by 10°C within 8 minutes of heating.

soldesc.p: Possible action for electrical heated machine:
a. Check that there is no break in the element.
b. Check that the heating contactor is not stuck.
Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check the steam valve.
b. Check that the ball valve is open and that the incoming steam filter is clean.
c. Check the steam pressure.
d. Check condensate drain.
e. Check that there is no back-pressure in the condensate drain.

malfunction.mdesc: A26 CHAMB TEMP H

causedesc.p: The temperature in the chamber is more than 5°C above the current reference point.

soldesc.p: Possible action for electrical heated machine:
a. Check that the heating contactor is not stuck.
b. Check that incoming water is not hotter than the set value.
Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check that the steam valve is not stuck.
b. Check that incoming water is not hottert han the set value.

malfunction.mdesc: A27 T DIFF CHAMB

causedesc.p: The temperature difference between the chamber sensors is more than 3°C for 3 seconds.
The alarm is only activated if the temperature in the chamber reaches its reference point.

soldesc.p: a. Check the calibration of the temperature sensors
b. Check the function of the temperature sensors.

malfunction.mdesc: A28 DISINF TEM L

causedesc.p: The final rinse time + 60 seconds has passed.

soldesc.p: Possible action for electrical heated machine:
a. Check that there is no break in the element.
b. Check that the heating contactor is not stuck.
Possible action for steam heated machine:
a. Check that the steam valve is not stuck.

malfunction.mdesc: A31 COND SENS

causedesc.p: Error in conductivity sensor (option).

soldesc.p: a. Check the conductivity sensor (for outage or short circuit).

malfunction.mdesc: A32 CIRC PR SENS

causedesc.p: Error in circulation pump's pressure sensor (option).

soldesc.p: a. Check the circulation pressure sensor (for outage or short circuit).

malfunction.mdesc: A34 T SENS DRYER

causedesc.p: Error in dryer temperature sensor.

soldesc.p: a. Check the temperature sensor (for outage or short-circuit).

malfunction.mdesc: A35 T SENS CHAMB

causedesc.p: Error in chamber temperature sensor

soldesc.p: a. Check the temperature sensor (for outage or short-circuit).

malfunction.mdesc: A36 I SENS CHAMB

causedesc.p: Error in independent temperature sensor in the chamber.

soldesc.p: a. Check the temperature sensor (for outage or short-circuit).

malfunction.mdesc: A38 CONFIG ERROR

causedesc.p: Configuration error.

soldesc.p: a. Check the combinations of parameter flags and DIP switches, and rectify those that are incorrect.

malfunction.mdesc: A40 PROC ABORTED

causedesc.p: Process aborted after the start button was pushed for 3 sec.

soldesc.p: Process interrupted by user.

malfunction.mdesc: A41 I/O FAULT

causedesc.p: Error in I2C communication bus or I/O card.

soldesc.p: a. Check cables.

malfunction.mdesc: A53 EXT COM ERR

causedesc.p: If DS17 Netcom is selected and the communication with Netcom is faulty. (If SF215 is set) (Option)

soldesc.p: a. Check cables.
b. Check the settings.

malfunction.mdesc: A54 LOG FAILURE

causedesc.p: If DS17 Netcom is selected and the log fails. (If SF217 and SF218 have not been reached within 2 min. aftert he end of process.) (Option)

soldesc.p: a. Check the USB memory stick.
b. Check the settings.
